summary.text: Dean Fisher is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 53 and has served in the Iowa House since 2013.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's biography for the 89th General Assembly (2021) says Fisher was born in 1956 in Garwin, lives in the rural Garwin and Montour area, and has a bachelor's degree in electronics engineering technology from DeVry Institute of Technology in Chicago (1978).

It lists 26 years in the electronics industry as an engineer, engineering manager and business manager (1978-2004), farming from 2004 to 2014, and service as Indian Village Township clerk, precinct election chairman and Republican county chairman.
